markets-finance.excerpt: The carrier beat Q2 earnings estimates on record $16.74 billion revenue, but a collapsing US-Iran ceasefire and surging jet fuel prices forced a sharp downward revision to full-year guidance, sending shares down over 4%.

markets-finance.image_caption: Comcast's corporate headquarters in Philadelphia. The company reported stronger-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings as Peacock streaming service turned its first profit.

markets-finance.title: Sensex, Nifty Extend Losses for Fourth Day as Crude Oil Nears $100
markets-finance.excerpt: Brent crude surged past $98 a barrel on escalating US-Iran tensions and Houthi attacks on Red Sea tankers, dragging Indian benchmarks to their longest losing streak in seven weeks.

markets-finance.title: Vishal Mega Mart Shares Tumble After Q1 Results Despite 26% Profit Jump

markets-finance.image_caption: Coverage of Vishal Mega Mart's Q1 FY27 earnings announcement. The value retailer posted 25.6% profit growth but its stock fell sharply on growth deceleration concerns.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian diaspora investors tracking VMM since its December 2024 IPO face a familiar tension between strong retail fundamentals and elevated valuations as growth normalizes.

markets-finance.excerpt: DCM Shriram Group delivered the first EXIM-certified container to Maersk at Dadri, Uttar Pradesh, backed by a ₹10,000 crore government scheme to build domestic manufacturing capacity tenfold.
